definitions.full: H6551. Parosh II. מַּרְעשׁ proper name, masculine φορος, φαρες , etc., (flea; compare Gray Prop. N. 94 ); — 1 head of post-exilic family Ezra 2:3 = Neh 7:8 ; Ezra 8:3 ; 10:25 ; Neh 3:25 . 2 Neh 10:15 .
